ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad white central region with continuous black pigmentation along the trailing edge; a dense black patch at the central vertex (notch); two distinct circular black spots on the lower-mid right lobe; sparse black mottling on the mid-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate 70-degree interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged serrations along the entire trailing edge; higher amplitude of variation observed on the left lobe's outer margin; fine-grained serration on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curving lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two prominent circular dark clusters on the right lobe; several smaller dark points concentrated near the right fluke tip and central vertex.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct diagonal dark linear disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe; one short horizontal mark on the outer left margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible diagonal rake marks on the right lobe and irregular chipping/erosion of the trailing edge boundary.
